text:
Maria - Infra: Heads up — finance just signaled the product team wants to lift the per-minute rate for Pro-tier next month. we need a quick sensitivity scrub on GPU headroom and burst policy impact.

Kevin - SRE: Copy. do we have a target uplift % yet?

Sam - Sales: PMs said +25% per-minute tokens for Pro, and a small quota bump for Starter customers moving to Pro. rough numbers, not final.

Shreya - Capacity: ok running a couple sims. which pools do we rebucket for headroom? eu-west vs us-west?

Maria - Infra: primary worry is EU low-capacity clusters during their business hours. suggest shifting 10% reserved from non-prod eu pools into pro-burst and enable cross-region fallback for short windows.

Lia - Oncall: cross-region fallback sounds good but watch KV cache cold-start penalty. oncall will get noisy alerts if we hit >30% cross-region traffic.

OpsBot: deploy/burst-config check: current pro-reserved = 120 GPUs, non-prod-eu = 40 GPUs.

Shreya - Capacity: quick calc: +25% rate -> estimated 18% increase in GPU-hours (based on token distribution). if we rebucket 8 GPUs from non-prod eu to pro-burst, headroom reduces outage probability from ~6% to ~1.5% during peak.

Kevin - SRE: can you paste the sim command and results?

Shreya - Capacity: sure — run used model: rwd-1-16b quantized, traffic model: q4m_token_hist_peak.json

```
./simulate_headroom --input=q4m_token_hist_peak.json --reserved=120 --rebucket-eu=8 --cross_region_fallback=true --out=sim_pro_25pct.json
# result: peak_loss_prob=0.015, expected_gpu_hours_delta=+0.18
```

Kevin - SRE: thanks. two follow-ups: 1) what about cost delta? 2) do we need procurement lead time for extra capacity?

Shreya - Capacity: cost delta is mostly transient — estimated +12% infra spend for the month if traffic stays elevated. procurement: if we need permanent GPUs, lead time is 6-8 weeks; but short-term rebucketing and enabling burst pools covers next 4 weeks.

Sam - Sales: product wants to ship the rate change first week of month. is the short-term plan sufficient?

Maria - Infra: yes for an initial roll. we should pair the rollout with an automated throttle policy that degrades gracefully (reduce per-request token cap) at 95th percentile latency. will coordinate with devex on API messaging.

Lia - Oncall: I'll add a temporary runbook: if cross-region >25% and error-rate >1% for 10m, cut Pro burst back by 50% and enable canary fallback to smaller model.

Kevin - SRE: please also add a Prometheus alert for pro_pool_gpu_utilization > 88% sustained for 5m. quick snippet: `avg_over_time(gpu_utilization{pool="pro"}[5m]) > 0.88`

OpsBot: note created: ticket INFRA-8421 "Pro tier rate lift — burst rebucket + alerts"

Maria - Infra: action items: 1) Shreya run final sim with updated token hist from billing (due EOD). 2) Lia write runbook + alert (by EOD). 3) Kevin add Prom rule + dashboard panel. 4) Maria coordinate devex message and sync with sales.

Shreya - Capacity: started sim, will post results here once complete.

Sam - Sales: thx team — PMs want a go/no-go by Friday.

Maria - Infra: noted. we'll aim to present numbers at Friday sync. :thumbsup:
